scope: Additive Royal Champion Seeking Shield L1-18 active projectile, Defense selection and bounce audit.
game_version: Official 2019 release, 2021 Builder exclusion, 2024 targeting and timing changes; dated secondary claimed client build 18.600.3; pinned raw commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba.

sources.title: A Fourth Hero Comes To The Home Village!
sources.levels: historical Hero ability; Equipment L1-18 mapping later
facts: Royal Champion hurls Seeking Shield at four nearest Defenses regardless of range, dealing damage.
sources.limitations: Pre-Equipment wording does not specify current target metric, bounce order, per-level damage or timing.

sources.title: Summer Update Full Notes
facts: Seeking Shield no longer targets defensive Builders.
sources.limitations: Does not define targetability of other non-building entities or later changes.

sources.title: Hero Equipment
facts: Seeking Shield is Royal Champion Common active Equipment that damages multiple targets and increases her HP.
sources.limitations: No current damage, target count, first target geometry or activation order is supplied.

sources.title: February 2024 Update - Patch Notes
facts: Seeking Shield timing and animation were fixed.
sources.limitations: No delay, flight speed, impact tick or animation-to-damage relationship is disclosed.

sources.title: June Update: Full Patch Notes
facts: Equipment initial target selection considers building size rather than only its midpoint; Seeking Shield is named as affected.
sources.limitations: No distance formula, footprint edges, tie-break or later bounce search rule is given.

sources.title: Seeking Shield — Clash of Clans Wiki

facts: Dated table matches pinned L1-18 Royal Champion HP bonus 40-380 and ore costs; describes bouncing between Defenses.
sources.limitations: Current projectile damage and actual bounce rule are not tabulated.

derivations.result: Record four Defense targets without range limit at launch, defensive Builder exclusion and building-size-aware first selection
derivations.method: Read 2019 launch, 2021 Builder change, 2023 Equipment conversion and June 2024 targeting change together; do not substitute midpoint distance.

derivations.result: Retain pinned projectile damage and HP bonus as catalogue fields; dated 2026 source confirms HP only
derivations.method: Compare pinned raw series with dated 2026 Equipment table and keep damage continuity unresolved.

rejected_inferences.rule: Choose first target by Champion-to-building-center distance
rejected_inferences.reason: June 2024 official note explicitly includes building size in initial selection without the metric.

rejected_inferences.rule: Search each bounce by the nearest Defense to the previous hit
rejected_inferences.reason: The launch describes four nearest Defenses but does not publish per-bounce ranking or repeat policy.

rejected_inferences.rule: Use the Champion's normal attack target or range
rejected_inferences.reason: Official launch specifies unlimited shield range and its own Defense selection.

rejected_inferences.rule: Apply projectile damage on the command tick
rejected_inferences.reason: The 2024 timing fix does not provide launch delay, flight, impact or simultaneous damage order.

rejected_inferences.rule: Hit defensive Builders or every ground-and-air entity
rejected_inferences.reason: Defensive Builders are excluded and the official target description names Defenses; raw target-layer text does not widen target categories.

items: current projectile damage and HP bonus continuity
first-target footprint metric, eligible Defense classes and deterministic ties
subsequent bounce search, repeat, destroyed-target and fewer-than-four behavior
launch, travel, impact, damage and death tick order
HP bonus stacking and Champion max/current HP conversion
Guardian, Pet, trap and other Equipment interactions
Viewer projectile/right-to-use art, snapshot, replay and RL activation state

conclusion: Seeking Shield L1-18 remains partial and catalogue-only. Official sources establish an active multi-Defense shield, historical four-target unlimited range, defensive Builder exclusion and size-aware first selection; exact current damage, target geometry, bounce and impact timing remain unresolved. No Equipment Core actor is enabled.
